R737.note: ECB replaced with AesGcm and a fresh 12-byte nonce; the response now carries nonce||tag||ciphertext, which is inherent to the mode change and shown plainly in the fix code.

R738.note: Deletion is moved off GET behind a doubleCsrfProtection-guarded POST, so the vector is closed, but the confirmation page is broken: doubleCsrfProtection.generateToken does not exist and req.csrfToken is only set when the middleware runs (it is not on the GET chain), so GET /account/delete throws a 500, and even with a token csrf-csrf reads it from the x-csrf-token header by default, not a csrf_token form field, so the form POST would 403 - while the write-up claims the email flow is intact.

R739.note: Extension now comes from a fixed map keyed by the already-validated detected type; only observable change is a normalized extension in the returned name, which is stated.

R740.note: GetFullPath canonicalization plus a GetRelativePath containment check rejects both ../ escapes and rooted filenames, and the validated path is the one read.

R741.note: Removing the /api/billing/** exclusion restores default CsrfFilter coverage; token-bearing authenticated PATCHes still succeed and no other exclusion is touched.

R742.note: Email route moved to protectedMux alongside profile; handler and 405/202 behaviour untouched.

R743.note: Full-match [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64} allowlist excludes every cmd.exe metacharacter before the batch re-entry, but it is a new restriction the case does not define (a report id with a space or dot the original accepted is now rejected with IllegalArgumentException), so 1 despite being stated.

R744.note: Removing [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] puts the action back under the global AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute filter; nothing else changes and the migrated-client comment supports the removal.

R745.note: CR/LF and other C0/DEL control characters are replaced with a space before the only log sink; normal usernames log unchanged and the substitution is stated.

R746.note: Wildcard-wrapped term is bound as a PDO parameter to a static :term placeholder, preserving the LIKE '%...%' substring semantics of the contract.

R747.note: Template source is now static and name is passed as a context variable, so it can never be parsed as Jinja2 syntax; the added HTML escaping is stated and blocks no legitimate use.

R748.note: No fix applied; the finding is treated as confirmed real but the write-up declares it not exploitable and leaves the sink untouched - I reproduced its runtime claim in the scratchpad with PHP 8.5.8 and an inert marker-file function and confirmed $$cmd() never reaches clearCache() for any input, so the claim is accurate, but the described allowlist-map dispatch was not applied and nothing observable changed.

R749.note: Manual payload decode replaced with firebase/php-jwt JWT::decode bound to a Key with a single HS256 algorithm (>=6.0.0 stated), key from server config; rejected tokens map to the same null outcome the original used for malformed tokens.
